hints.title: Ternary Base Representation
hints.text: A number is a sum of distinct powers of 3 if and only if its base 3 representation contains only 0s and 1s.

hints.title: Repeated Modulo by Three
hints.text: Repeatedly check n % 3. If the remainder is ever 2, the number cannot be represented using distinct powers.

hints.title: Divide by Three
hints.text: Divide n by 3 repeatedly until n reaches 0.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Subset sum exploration over powers of 3 is redundant when base 3 digits reveal structure directly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space base 3 conversion checks at most 15 ternary digits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies ternary expansion property: digit 2 implies non-distinct power reuse.
